title: SWF button not clickable: DefineButton2 records only set Up state (no HIT_TEST)
description:
ROOT CAUSE: encodeDefineButton2 (packages/swf/src/buttons.ts) built ButtonRecords by iterating keyframes and setting ONLY each frame's own state bit. The golden PlayButton has artwork only in its Up keyframe (no Over/Down/Hit frames), so our records carried only ButtonState(UP) and no HIT_TEST -> Ruffle/Flash have no hit area -> button never clickable -> on(release) never fires. Verified via swf-dump-style parse: golden.swf records = UP|OVER|DOWN|HIT (charId 5,6); ours = UP only (charId 10,11).

FIX (buttons.ts only): rewrote the record builder to (1) collect per-state keyframe display objects, (2) FORWARD-FILL each state's artwork into any LATER state with no keyframe of its own (Flash keyframe propagation; never backward, so an Up-only button promotes Up->Over->Down->Hit while a later-state-only button keeps an empty Up), (3) emit ONE record per object with all participating state bits OR'd (matching golden's single record/object with all 4 bits). Result: golden now publishes UP|OVER|DOWN|HIT on both PlayButton records, byte-matching golden.swf.

EVIDENCE:
- Structural (golden.fla -> compileDocument): both DefineButton2 records now = UP|OVER|DOWN|HIT (was UP only). Matches golden.swf.
- Unit: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run => all 5 button test files pass (71 tests); buttons.test.ts updated for forward-fill semantics (tests 2/9/10) + new test 12 (golden case: Up-only multi-object -> one all-4-states record each). Only unrelated glyphoutline.test.ts (2) fails due to another agent's in-progress fonts.ts (passes on committed fonts.ts; out of scope).
- E2E (apps/desktop/e2e/interactivity.spec.ts): added 'Up-only button publishes HIT_TEST records and a release action (1196)'. PASSES with fix, FAILS without (expected HIT 0x08, got 0). STRUCTURAL oracle by design: bundled headless Ruffle 0.1.0 hit-tests a button's VISIBLE bounds when no HIT_TEST record exists, so a Ruffle mouse-click advances an Up-only button even WITHOUT the fix and cannot distinguish fixed/broken (documented in the test). ruffle-core 0.2.0 avm1_button.rs mouse_pick_avm1 hit-tests only the HIT_TEST-derived hit_area, so HIT_TEST is the true acceptance signal; test inflates the browser-published SWF and asserts every Up record also carries HIT_TEST + a BUTTONCONDACTION is present.
- golden-parity exit policy unchanged: exit=1 on golden AND golden-v2 both with and without the fix (driven by the pre-existing TEXT PARITY gap, task 1195; buttons change does not alter it).
